<script>
/* ══ Tovus (n03) customizer + i18n + guestbook + countdown + music ══
   Base DOM language is Uzbek; apply() captures el.__uz once and swaps in
   EN/RU from DICT, skipping any element the owner filled (data-user-set). */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  var $ = function (s, r) { return (r || document).querySelector(s); };
  var esc = function (s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
    return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); };
  var setTxt = function (el, v) { if (el) { el.textContent = v; el.setAttribute("data-user-set", "1"); } };
  var hide = function (el) { if (el) el.style.display = "none"; };

  /* ── i18n dictionary: key -> [en, ru]; uz is read from the DOM ── */
  var DICT = {
    splash_kicker: ["Nikah Invitation", "Приглашение на никох"],
    splash_open: ["Open Invitation", "Открыть приглашение"],
    hero_kicker: ["We're getting married", "Мы создаём семью"],
    scroll_hint: ["scroll to begin", "Прокрутите вниз"],
    inv_kicker: ["Together with their families", "С благословения родителей"],
    inv_request: ["request the honour of your presence at the <span style=\"font-style:italic;color:var(--emerald);\">Nikah</span> of their beloved children", "просят вас разделить радость <span style=\"font-style:italic;color:var(--emerald);\">никоха</span> их дорогих детей"],
    groom_parents_default: ["Son of the Karimov family", "Сын семьи Каримовых"],
    bride_parents_default: ["Daughter of the Yusupov family", "Дочь семьи Юсуповых"],
    quote_default: ["“Two souls, one heart — the beginning of forever.”", "«Две души, одно сердце — начало вечности.»"],
    ev_kicker: ["The Celebrations", "Торжества"],
    ev_title: ["Order of Events", "Порядок торжества"],
    ev1_kicker: ["Ceremony", "Церемония"],
    ev1_title: ["Nikah", "Никох"],
    ev1_desc: ["The solemnisation of our marriage", "Священное таинство бракосочетания"],
    ev2_kicker: ["Reception", "Приём"],
    ev2_title: ["Walima", "Валима"],
    ev2_desc: ["Join us for dinner & celebration", "Праздничный ужин — ждём вас за нашим столом"],
    ev_when_label: ["When&nbsp;·&nbsp;", "Когда&nbsp;·&nbsp;"],
    ev_where_label: ["Where&nbsp;·&nbsp;", "Где&nbsp;·&nbsp;"],
    venue_kicker: ["The Venue", "Место торжества"],
    btn_map: ["Open Map", "Открыть карту"],
    info_kicker: ["Good to know", "Полезно знать"],
    info_title: ["Guest Information", "Информация для гостей"],
    info_dress_label: ["Dress Code", "Дресс-код"],
    info_timing_label: ["Timing", "Время"],
    info_rsvp_label: ["RSVP", "Подтверждение"],
    info_parking_label: ["Parking", "Парковка"],
    info_dress_default: ["Festive attire — emerald, turquoise and gold tones", "Праздничный наряд — оттенки изумруда, бирюзы и золота"],
    info_timing_default: ["Nikah 4:00 PM · Walima 7:00 PM", "Никох в 16:00 · Валима в 19:00"],
    info_rsvp_default: ["Kindly confirm by 1 August", "Просьба подтвердить до 1 августа"],
    info_parking_default: ["Parking available by the main gate", "Парковка у главных ворот"],
    wish_kicker: ["Guestbook", "Книга пожеланий"],
    wish_title: ["Leave your wishes", "Оставьте пожелание"],
    wish_sub: ["Your kind words mean the world to us", "Ваши тёплые слова очень важны для нас"],
    btn_send: ["Send your blessing", "Отправить пожелание"],
    wish_thanks: ["Thank you — your wish has been saved ♡", "Спасибо — ваше пожелание сохранено ♡"],
    wish_empty: ["Be the first to leave a wish for the couple.", "Будьте первым, кто оставит пожелание молодожёнам."],
    cd_kicker: ["Counting the days", "Отсчитываем дни"],
    cd_title: ["until we say “I do”", "до заветного дня"],
    cd_days: ["Days", "Дни"], cd_hours: ["Hours", "Часы"], cd_mins: ["Minutes", "Минуты"], cd_secs: ["Seconds", "Секунды"],
    cd_arrived: ["The day has finally arrived.", "Долгожданный день настал."],
    footer_note_default: ["With love and gratitude, we can't wait to celebrate with you.", "С любовью и благодарностью — с нетерпением ждём встречи с вами."]
  };
  var PH = {
    wish_name_ph: ["Your name", "Ваше имя"],
    wish_msg_ph: ["Write your message…", "Напишите пожелание…"]
  };
  /* localized month names + full weekday names, index 0 = Jan / Sunday */
  var MON = {
    uz: ["yanvar","fevral","mart","aprel","may","iyun","iyul","avgust","sentabr","oktabr","noyabr","dekabr"],
    en: ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"],
    ru: ["января","февраля","марта","апреля","мая","июня","июля","августа","сентября","октября","ноября","декабря"]
  };
  var DOWFULL = {
    uz: ["Yakshanba","Dushanba","Seshanba","Chorshanba","Payshanba","Juma","Shanba"],
    en: ["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"],
    ru: ["Воскресенье","Понедельник","Вторник","Среда","Четверг","Пятница","Суббота"]
  };

  /* ── language state ── */
  function norm(l) { l = (l || "").toLowerCase(); return l === "en" || l === "ru" ? l : "uz"; }
  var initLang = norm(q.get("lang") || q.get("default_lang") ||
    (function () { try { return localStorage.getItem("takliflaLang"); } catch (e) { return null; } })() ||
    document.documentElement.lang || "uz");
  window.__takliflaLang = initLang;

  var MW = {}; // stash of date parts for re-localisation (dd, mm, yy, dow, ev1Time)

  function localizeDate(lang) {
    if (!MW.dd) return;
    var months = MON[lang] || MON.uz;
    var dows = DOWFULL[lang] || DOWFULL.uz;
    var fEl = $("#tv-frame-date");
    if (fEl && fEl.getAttribute("data-user-set") !== "1") {
      fEl.textContent = MW.dd + " " + (months[MW.mm - 1] || "") + " " + MW.yy;
    }
    var footEl = $("#tv-foot-meta");
    if (footEl && footEl.getAttribute("data-user-set") !== "1") {
      footEl.textContent = MW.dd + " " + (months[MW.mm - 1] || "") + " " + MW.yy + (MW.city ? " · " + MW.city : "");
    }
    var e1 = $("#tv-ev1-when");
    if (e1 && e1.getAttribute("data-user-set") !== "1") {
      e1.textContent = dows[MW.dow] + ", " + MW.dd + " " + (months[MW.mm - 1] || "") + " " + MW.yy + " — " + MW.ev1Time;
    }
    var e2 = $("#tv-ev2-when");
    if (e2 && e2.getAttribute("data-user-set") !== "1") {
      e2.textContent = dows[MW.dow] + ", " + MW.dd + " " + (months[MW.mm - 1] || "") + " " + MW.yy + " — 19:00";
    }
  }

  function apply() {
    var lang = norm(window.__takliflaLang);
    var nodes = document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]");
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var el = nodes[i];
      if (el.getAttribute("data-user-set") === "1") continue;
      if (el.__uz == null) el.__uz = el.innerHTML;
      var pair = DICT[el.getAttribute("data-i18n")];
      el.innerHTML = lang === "uz" || !pair ? el.__uz : (lang === "en" ? pair[0] : pair[1]);
    }
    var phs = document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n-ph]");
    for (var j = 0; j < phs.length; j++) {
      var pe = phs[j];
      if (pe.__uzph == null) pe.__uzph = pe.getAttribute("placeholder") || "";
      var pp = PH[pe.getAttribute("data-i18n-ph")];
      pe.setAttribute("placeholder", lang === "uz" || !pp ? pe.__uzph : (lang === "en" ? pp[0] : pp[1]));
    }
    localizeDate(lang);
    var btns = document.querySelectorAll(".tv-lang button");
    for (var k = 0; k < btns.length; k++) btns[k].classList.toggle("on", btns[k].getAttribute("data-lang") === lang);
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  }

  /* ── language switcher ── */
  (function () {
    var wrap = $(".tv-lang");
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest("button[data-lang]");
      if (!b) return;
      var lang = norm(b.getAttribute("data-lang"));
      window.__takliflaLang = lang;
      try { localStorage.setItem("takliflaLang", lang); } catch (er) {}
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("taklifla:langchange", { detail: { lang: lang } }));
    });
  })();
  document.addEventListener("taklifla:langchange", apply);

  /* ── names ── */
  var names = q.get("names");
  var n1 = "", n2 = "";
  if (names && names.trim()) {
    // word separators (va/и) require surrounding whitespace so names that
    // contain them as substrings (Avazbek, Anvar, Дилшод) don't get split
    var parts = names.split(/\s*[&+—]\s*|\s+(?:va|и)\s+/i).filter(Boolean);
    n1 = (parts[0] || names).trim();
    n2 = (parts[1] || "").trim();
    if (n1) { setTxt($("#tv-hero-a"), n1); setTxt($("#tv-frame-groom"), n1); setTxt($("#tv-inv-groom"), n1); }
    var pair = n2 ? n1 + " & " + n2 : n1;
    setTxt($("#tv-splash-names"), pair);
    setTxt($("#tv-foot-names"), pair);
    if (n2) {
      setTxt($("#tv-hero-b"), n2);
      setTxt($("#tv-frame-bride"), n2);
      setTxt($("#tv-inv-bride"), n2);
    } else {
      hide($("#tv-hero-b")); hide($("#tv-hero-amp"));
      hide($("#tv-frame-bride")); hide($("#tv-frame-amp"));
      hide($("#tv-inv-bride-block")); hide($("#tv-inv-amp"));
    }
  }

  /* ── parents (owner) ── */
  var gp = q.get("groom_parents");
  if (gp != null) { if (gp.trim()) setTxt($("#tv-inv-groom-parents"), gp.trim()); else hide($("#tv-inv-groom-parents-wrap")); }
  var bp = q.get("bride_parents");
  if (bp != null) { if (bp.trim()) setTxt($("#tv-inv-bride-parents"), bp.trim()); else hide($("#tv-inv-bride-parents-wrap")); }

  /* ── quote (owner) ── */
  var quote = q.get("quote");
  if (quote != null) {
    // strip any quotes the owner typed, then re-wrap so the rendered line
    // always matches the base design's typographic “…” framing
    var qt = quote.trim().replace(/^["“”«»]+|["“”«»]+$/g, "").trim();
    if (qt) setTxt($("#tv-inv-quote"), "“" + qt + "”"); else hide($("#tv-quote-wrap"));
  }

  /* ── venue / address / map ── */
  var venue = q.get("venue");
  var city = "";
  var addr = q.get("address");
  if (addr && addr.trim()) {
    setTxt($("#tv-venue-addr"), addr.trim());
    // Uzbek addresses are city-FIRST ("Toshkent sh., Yunusobod tumani"):
    // prefer a leading segment carrying a city marker; otherwise take the
    // last segment only if it doesn't look like a street/district.
    var segs = addr.split(",").map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    var cm = segs[0] && (segs[0].match(/^(.+?)\s+(?:sh\.?|shahri|шаҳри|ш\.)$/i) || segs[0].match(/^(?:г|g)\.\s*(.+)$/i));
    if (cm) city = cm[1].trim();
    else {
      var tail = segs[segs.length - 1] || "";
      city = /(tuman|ko'?cha|kuchasi|mavze|mahalla|MFY|uy\b|ул\.|улиц|дом|туман|кўча|street|district|avenue)/i.test(tail) ? "" : tail;
    }
  }
  if (venue && venue.trim()) {
    setTxt($("#tv-venue-name"), venue.trim());
    setTxt($("#tv-hero-venue"), venue.trim());
  }
  MW.city = city;
  if (city) {
    setTxt($("#tv-hero-city"), city);
  } else {
    // no derivable city — drop the chip so the demo default never lingers
    // next to an owner-entered venue
    hide($("#tv-hero-city-wrap"));
  }
  var mapUrl = q.get("map_url");
  var mapEl = $("#tv-map");
  if (mapEl) {
    // only http(s) — blocks javascript:/data: schemes from the owner param
    if (mapUrl && /^https?:\/\//i.test(mapUrl.trim())) mapEl.setAttribute("href", mapUrl.trim());
    else if (addr && addr.trim()) mapEl.setAttribute("href", "https://maps.google.com/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(addr.trim()));
    else if (venue && venue.trim()) mapEl.setAttribute("href", "https://maps.google.com/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(venue.trim()));
  }
  /* events "Qayerda" (where) lines always reflect current venue+city,
     independent of whether a date was parsed */
  (function () {
    if (!venue && !addr) return;
    var vName = (venue && venue.trim()) || $("#tv-venue-name").textContent;
    var whereText = vName + (city ? ", " + city : "");
    var e1w = $("#tv-ev1-where"); if (e1w && e1w.getAttribute("data-user-set") !== "1") setTxt(e1w, whereText);
    var e2w = $("#tv-ev2-where"); if (e2w && e2w.getAttribute("data-user-set") !== "1") setTxt(e2w, whereText);
  })();

  /* ── info rows (owner; empty hides the row; all-four-empty hides section) ── */
  (function () {
    var rows = [["info_dress", "#tv-info-dress", "#tv-info-dress-text"],
      ["info_timing", "#tv-info-timing", "#tv-info-timing-text"],
      ["info_rsvp", "#tv-info-rsvp", "#tv-info-rsvp-text"],
      ["info_parking", "#tv-info-parking", "#tv-info-parking-text"]];
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var v = q.get(r[0]);
      if (v == null) return;
      if (v.trim()) setTxt($(r[2]), v.trim()); else hide($(r[1]));
    });
    var anyVisible = rows.some(function (r) { var el = $(r[1]); return el && el.style.display !== "none"; });
    if (!anyVisible) hide($("#tv-info-section"));
  })();

  /* ── footer note (owner) ── */
  var fnote = q.get("footer_note");
  if (fnote != null) { if (fnote.trim()) { var fe = $("#tv-foot-note"); if (fe) { fe.innerHTML = esc(fnote.trim()).replace(/\n/g, "<br>"); fe.setAttribute("data-user-set", "1"); } } else hide($("#tv-foot-note")); }

  /* ── date + time ── */
  var rawDate = q.get("date");
  var rawTime = q.get("time");
  var target = null;
  if (rawDate) {
    var m = rawDate.match(/^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})$/);
    var iso = rawDate.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/);
    var dd, mm, yy;
    if (m) { dd = +m[1]; mm = +m[2]; yy = +m[3]; }
    else if (iso) { yy = +iso[1]; mm = +iso[2]; dd = +iso[3]; }
    if (dd) {
      var hh = 16, mi = 0;
      if (rawTime) { var tp = rawTime.split(":"); hh = parseInt(tp[0], 10); mi = parseInt(tp[1], 10) || 0; if (isNaN(hh)) hh = 16; }
      var dObj = new Date(yy, mm - 1, dd, hh, mi, 0);
      var p2 = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; };
      MW.dd = dd; MW.mm = mm; MW.yy = yy; MW.dow = dObj.getDay(); MW.ev1Time = p2(hh) + ":" + p2(mi);
      target = dObj;
      window.__INV_TARGET__ = dObj.getTime();
      setTxt($("#tv-hero-date"), p2(dd) + " · " + p2(mm) + " · " + yy);
      setTxt($("#tv-splash-date"), p2(dd) + " · " + p2(mm) + " · " + yy);
    }
  }

  /* ── events timeline (owner list overrides defaults) ── */
  (function () {
    var raw = q.get("events");
    if (raw == null) return;
    var rows;
    try { rows = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { return; }
    if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return;
    var section = $("#tv-events-section");
    var live = rows.filter(function (r) { return r && (r.title || r.description || r.time || r.place); });
    if (!live.length) { hide(section); return; }
    var host = $("#tv-events");
    var spine = host.firstElementChild;
    host.innerHTML = "";
    if (spine) host.appendChild(spine);
    live.forEach(function (r) {
      var meta = [r.time, r.place].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      var row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "tv-ev-row";
      row.setAttribute("data-reveal", "");
      row.style.position = "relative";
      row.style.marginBottom = "30px";
      row.innerHTML =
        '<div style="position:absolute;left:-40px;top:2px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ivory);border:1px solid var(--gold);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;"><div style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, var(--peacock) 0 22%, var(--gold) 26% 52%, var(--teal) 58% 100%);"></div></div>' +
        '<div style="background:linear-gradient(180deg, #FCFAF3, #F3ECDD);padding:24px 24px 26px;border:1px solid rgba(198,162,74,.22);box-shadow:0 24px 46px -30px rgba(12,30,26,.4), 0 8px 18px -14px rgba(12,30,26,.24), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55);">' +
          (r.title ? '<div style="font-family:\'Cormorant Garamond\',serif;font-size:27px;font-weight:500;color:var(--emerald);line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:6px;">' + esc(r.title) + '</div>' : '') +
          (meta ? '<div style="font-family:\'Cormorant Garamond\',serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:12px;color:var(--teal-2);margin-bottom:10px;">' + esc(meta) + '</div>' : '') +
          (r.description ? '<p style="font-family:\'Cormorant Garamond\',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;">' + esc(r.description) + '</p>' : '') +
        '</div>';
      host.appendChild(row);
    });
    // freshly-built rows have no prior transition state — reveal immediately
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll("[data-reveal]"), function (n) { n.classList.add("tv-in"); });
  })();

  /* ── countdown ── */
  (function () {
    var grid = $("#tv-cd-grid"), arrived = $("#tv-cd-arrived");
    var cd = { d: $("#tv-cd-d"), h: $("#tv-cd-h"), m: $("#tv-cd-m"), s: $("#tv-cd-s") };
    if (!cd.d) return;
    var when = target || new Date(2026, 7, 14, 16, 0, 0);
    function tick() {
      var diff = when.getTime() - Date.now();
      if (diff <= 0) {
        if (grid) grid.style.display = "none";
        if (arrived) arrived.style.display = "block";
        cd.d.textContent = "0"; cd.h.textContent = "00"; cd.m.textContent = "00"; cd.s.textContent = "00";
        return;
      }
      var day = 86400000;
      cd.d.textContent = Math.floor(diff / day);
      cd.h.textContent = ("0" + Math.floor(diff % day / 3600000)).slice(-2);
      cd.m.textContent = ("0" + Math.floor(diff % 3600000 / 60000)).slice(-2);
      cd.s.textContent = ("0" + Math.floor(diff % 60000 / 1000)).slice(-2);
    }
    tick();
    setInterval(tick, 1000);
  })();

  /* ── splash open ── */
  (function () {
    var splash = $("#tv-splash");
    var opened = false;
    if (splash) document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    function open() {
      if (opened) return; opened = true;
      if (splash) {
        splash.style.opacity = "0";
        splash.style.transform = "translateX(-50%) translateY(-26px)";
        splash.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        setTimeout(function () { splash.style.display = "none"; }, 1100);
      }
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    }
    var ob = $("#tv-open");
    if (ob) ob.addEventListener("click", open);
    if (!splash) document.body.style.overflow = "";
  })();

  /* ── feather-mask JS fallback (harmless duplicate of the inline style) ── */
  (function () {
    var f = $("#tv-frame-img");
    if (!f) return;
    var mVal = "radial-gradient(118% 98% at 50% 48%, #000 64%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%)";
    f.style.webkitMaskImage = mVal;
    f.style.maskImage = mVal;
    f.style.webkitMaskRepeat = f.style.maskRepeat = "no-repeat";
    f.style.webkitMaskSize = f.style.maskSize = "100% 100%";
  })();

  /* ── music (?audio) + first-gesture handshake with the parent shell ── */
  (function () {
    var audio = $("#tv-audio"), btn = $("#tv-music");
    var onI = $("#tv-music-on"), offI = $("#tv-music-off");
    var url = q.get("audio");
    var playing = false;
    function setIcon() { if (onI) onI.style.display = playing ? "flex" : "none"; if (offI) offI.style.display = playing ? "none" : "flex"; }
    if (url && audio && btn) {
      audio.src = url;
      btn.style.display = "flex";
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (playing) { audio.pause(); playing = false; }
        else { audio.play().then(function () { playing = true; setIcon(); }).catch(function () {}); }
        setIcon();
      });
    }
    var fired = false;
    var evs = ["pointerdown", "touchstart", "keydown"];
    function once() {
      if (fired) return; fired = true;
      try { if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) window.parent.postMessage("taklifla:gesture", "*"); } catch (e) {}
      evs.forEach(function (x) { window.removeEventListener(x, once, true); });
    }
    evs.forEach(function (x) { window.addEventListener(x, once, { capture: true, passive: true }); });
  })();

  /* ── reveal on scroll (IO + no-IO fallback + reduced-motion respected) ── */
  (function () {
    var els = document.querySelectorAll("[data-reveal]");
    var reduced = false;
    try { reduced = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches; } catch (e) {}
    if (reduced || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
      for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) els[i].classList.add("tv-in");
      return;
    }
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (ents) {
      ents.forEach(function (en) {
        if (en.isIntersecting) {
          var d = parseInt(en.target.getAttribute("data-reveal-delay") || "0", 10);
          if (d) en.target.style.transitionDelay = d + "ms";
          en.target.classList.add("tv-in");
          io.unobserve(en.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.14, rootMargin: "0px 0px -7% 0px" });
    for (var j = 0; j < els.length; j++) io.observe(els[j]);
  })();

  /* ── floating particles (6 dots, ported from buildParticles) ── */
  (function () {
    var host = $("#tv-particles");
    if (!host) return;
    var n = 6;
    var tints = ["#C6A24A", "#0E6B62"];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var size = 3 + (i % 3) * 2;
      var left = (8 + i * 15) % 100;
      var dur = 28 + (i * 13 % 14);
      var delay = -(i * 37 % 26);
      var drift = ((i % 2) ? 1 : -1) * (14 + (i * 11 % 30));
      var tint = tints[i % tints.length];
      var d = document.createElement("div");
      d.style.cssText = "position:absolute;top:-6vh;left:" + left + "%;width:" + size + "px;height:" + size +
        "px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, " + tint + " 0 22%, rgba(198,162,74,.26) 28% 52%, transparent 60%);" +
        "opacity:.22;--drift:" + drift + "px;animation:fall " + dur + "s linear " + delay + "s infinite;";
      host.appendChild(d);
    }
  })();

  /* ── guestbook (wishes) ── */
  (function () {
    var slug = q.get("slug");
    var form = $("#tv-wish-form"), list = $("#tv-wish-list");
    var empty = $("#tv-wish-empty"), confirm = $("#tv-wish-confirm");
    if (!form || !list) return;
    var KEY = "takliflaWishSubmitted:" + (slug || "demo");

    function render(items) {
      list.innerHTML = "";
      if (!items || !items.length) { if (empty) empty.style.display = "block"; return; }
      if (empty) empty.style.display = "none";
      items.forEach(function (w) {
        var name = w.name || w.n || "";
        var msg = w.message || w.m || "";
        var c = document.createElement("div");
        c.style.cssText = "background:rgba(255,255,255,.66);border:1px solid rgba(198,162,74,.22);border-radius:2px;padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:0 14px 28px -22px rgba(12,30,26,.34);";
        c.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:6px;">' +
          '<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, var(--peacock) 0 24%, var(--gold) 28% 56%, var(--teal) 60% 100%);flex:none;"></div>' +
          '<div style="font-family:\'Cormorant Garamond\',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:18px;color:var(--emerald);">' + esc(name) + '</div></div>' +
          '<div style="font-family:\'Cormorant Garamond\',serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink);white-space:pre-wrap;">' + esc(msg) + '</div>';
        list.appendChild(c);
      });
    }
    function lock() { form.style.display = "none"; if (confirm) confirm.style.display = "block"; }

    if (!slug) {
      var demo = [];
      try { demo = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tvDemoWishes") || "[]"); } catch (e) {}
      render(demo);
      form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var n = form.elements.wname.value.trim(), msg = form.elements.wmsg.value.trim();
        if (!n || !msg) return;
        demo.unshift({ name: n, message: msg });
        try { localStorage.setItem("tvDemoWishes", JSON.stringify(demo)); } catch (er) {}
        render(demo); form.reset();
      });
      return;
    }

    var URL = "/api/v1/public/i/" + encodeURIComponent(slug) + "/guestbook";
    function load() {
      fetch(URL, { credentials: "omit" }).then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : []; })
        .then(function (items) { render(items || []); }).catch(function () {});
    }
    form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var n = form.elements.wname.value.trim(), msg = form.elements.wmsg.value.trim();
      if (!n || !msg) return;
      var btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
      if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
      fetch(URL, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: n, message: msg }), credentials: "omit" })
        .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("http_" + r.status); return r.json(); })
        .then(function () { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, "1"); } catch (er) {} form.reset(); lock(); load(); })
        .catch(function () { if (btn) btn.disabled = false; });
    });
    load();
    try { if (localStorage.getItem(KEY) === "1") lock(); } catch (e) {}
  })();

  apply();
})();
</script>
<script src="_wish-close.js" defer></script>
